understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game is won, while avoiding spikes.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. Spike tiles cause an immediate failure, while support tiles are safe. CLICK with a target position interacts with clickable tiles such as breakable blocks, typically removing them to open a gravity path; clicks do not advance the rising-platform timer. UNDO reverts the previous action. Each level provides two attempts with up to 50 turns, and landing predictions plus corridor passages should guide movement toward useful lower or upper sections.
